name: ai-polish-skills
description: Oficjalny rejestr polskich skilli dla agentów AI (Claude Code, Cursor, Windsurf, Antigravity)

skills.name: adresy
skills.description: Geocode Polish addresses and reverse GPS using official GUGiK UUG. Znajdź polski adres, ulicę lub miejscowość i ich współrzędne GPS; odczytaj najbliższy punkt adresowy dla GPS. Użyj dla „współrzędne adresu”, „znajdź adres”, „jaki adres pod GPS”, „geocode Polish address”, „reverse geocoding Poland”. Zachowuje niejednoznaczne dopasowania; nie ustala granic działki ani właściciela.
skills.author: Michell Hoduń (https://github.com/b44x)
skills.source: Główny Urząd Geodezji i Kartografii — UUG
skills.rate_limit: fair use; no published request quota; one request per command
skills.compatibility: Python 3.8+ (standard library only).

skills.name: biala-lista
skills.description: Check Polish businesses and VAT status in the official Ministry of Finance White List (Biała Lista Podatników VAT). Verify active VAT payer status (Czynny / Zwolniony / Niezarejestrowany), legal company name, REGON, KRS, registered address, and settlement bank accounts by NIP or REGON. Check if a contractor's bank account is on the whitelist before making B2B transfers (critical for split payment and tax deductibility above 15,000 PLN). Reverse-lookup company by 26-digit Polish bank account number (NRB/IBAN). Validate NIP, REGON, and IBAN checksums offline. Use whenever the user asks about NIP, REGON, Biała Lista VAT, "sprawdź NIP", "sprawdź kontrahenta", "status VAT spółki", "czy numer konta jest na białej liście", or verifying a Polish invoice.
skills.author: Michell Hoduń (https://github.com/b44x)
skills.compatibility: Python 3.8+ (standard library only); network access to wl-api.mf.gov.pl.

skills.name: ceny-deweloperow
skills.description: Read developer asking-price files hosted by dane.gov.pl and reconstruct observed price changes for one apartment or house. Use for „historia ceny mieszkania”, „czy deweloper podniósł cenę przed promocją”, „porównaj opublikowane cenniki”. Reports dates, absolute and percentage changes, and missing observations. Supports recognized JSON, CSV, XLSX and SpreadsheetML XML schemas; coverage depends on available files. For completed sale prices use nieruchomosci.
skills.author: Michell Hoduń (https://github.com/b44x)
skills.rate_limit: fair use; up to 100 catalog records per page; at most three explicitly selected files
skills.compatibility: Python 3.8+ (standard library only).

skills.name: cert-pl
skills.description: Check a domain or HTTP(S) URL against the active CERT Polska warning list, including matching subdomains. Use for "sprawdź link", "podejrzany SMS", "dopłata do paczki", "czy domena jest na liście CERT". Does not visit the submitted URL or certify that an unlisted site is safe.
skills.author: Michell Hoduń (https://github.com/b44x)
skills.rate_limit: Local cache: 5 minutes; no published request quota
skills.compatibility: Python 3.8+ (standard library only); internet access required.

skills.name: dzialki
skills.description: Locate Polish cadastral parcels through the official ULDK service by full EGiB identifier, cadastral district and parcel number, or a point inside the parcel. Return administrative location and parcel footprint in WKT and WGS84 GeoJSON. Use for "znajdź działkę", "granice działki", "identyfikator działki", "jaka działka w tym punkcie". Does not retrieve ownership, land-register numbers or building permission.
skills.author: Michell Hoduń (https://github.com/b44x)
skills.source: Główny Urząd Geodezji i Kartografii — ULDK
skills.compatibility: Python 3.8+ (standard library only); internet access required.

skills.name: energia
skills.description: Read official Polish PSE market electricity prices (RCE), find the cheapest continuous consumption window and summarize historical prices. Use for "ceny RCE", "ceny energii PSE", "najtańsze godziny prądu" or "kiedy ładować przy cenach rynkowych". Reports complete and missing intervals; retail tariffs depend on the user's contract.
skills.author: Michell Hoduń (https://github.com/b44x)
skills.rate_limit: fair use; local cache 5 minutes; maximum 31 days per query
skills.compatibility: Python 3.8+ (standard library only); internet access required.

skills.name: filmweb
skills.description: Fetch film and TV series data from Filmweb.pl: search by title, rating and number of votes, critics rating, genres, duration, directors, cast, plot, premiere dates, where to watch (VOD providers and prices) and actor details. Use whenever the user asks about a movie or series on Filmweb, pastes a filmweb.pl link, or wants a Polish rating, opis, obsada or VOD info, e.g. "ile Matrix ma na Filmwebie", "kto grał w…", "kto wyreżyserował…", "o czym jest…", "gdzie obejrzę…", "kiedy premiera…", "jaki serial…", "ocena serialu…".
skills.author: Michell Hoduń (https://github.com/b44x)
skills.compatibility: Python 3.8+ (standard library only); network access to www.filmweb.pl.

skills.name: imgw
skills.description: Fetch official meteorological and hydrological data for Poland from the Instytut Meteorologii i Gospodarki Wodnej (IMGW-PIB). Check current temperature, atmospheric pressure, humidity, wind speed and direction, and rainfall totals from synoptic stations (Warszawa, Kraków, Gdańsk, Zakopane and 58 others). Find the nearest weather station by GPS coordinates. Fetch official meteorological warnings (storms, gales, heat, frost) and hydrological warnings (hydrological drought, river water levels, alarm and warning levels on the Wisła, Odra, etc.). No API keys, 100% official public data. Use whenever the user asks about: "pogoda IMGW", "jaka jest temperatura w Warszawie", "ostrzeżenia IMGW", "stan Wisły", "stan wody", "alerty pogodowe", "ciśnienie", "wiatr", "opady w Polsce".
skills.author: Michell Hoduń (https://github.com/b44x)
skills.compatibility: Python 3.8+ (standard library only); network access to danepubliczne.imgw.pl.

skills.name: inpost
skills.description: Track InPost shipments and find Paczkomat parcel lockers and pickup points across Poland. Check shipment status and historical events by 24-digit tracking number (e.g. "gdzie moja paczka InPost", "status przesyłki"). Look up Paczkomat locker details by code (e.g. WAW01M, KRA01A) including address, location description, 24/7 accessibility, easy access zone (Strefa Łatwego Dostępu), payment options, and photo. Search lockers by city, street, postal code, or find nearest Paczkomaty by GPS coordinates with distances in meters. Use whenever the user asks about an InPost parcel, Paczkomat location, "gdzie jest paczkomat", "najbliższy paczkomat", or pastes an InPost tracking link/number.
skills.author: Michell Hoduń (https://github.com/b44x)
skills.compatibility: Python 3.8+ (standard library only); network access to api-shipx-pl.easypack24.net.

skills.name: krs
skills.description: Fetch official company and foundation records from Krajowy Rejestr Sądowy (KRS) via the Ministry of Justice API. Retrieve company legal status, board members (zarząd), supervisory council (rada nadzorcza), commercial proxies (prokurenci), share capital, registered address, NIP, REGON, and exact legal representation rules (sposób reprezentacji: kto może podpisywać umowy). Checks both commercial companies (Rejestr Przedsiębiorców P: Sp. z o.o., S.A., P.S.A.) and non-profits (Rejestr Stowarzyszeń/Fundacji S). Automatically pads KRS numbers to 10 digits. Use whenever the user asks about KRS, "kto może podpisać umowę", "sprawdź spółkę w KRS", "odpis KRS", "zarząd spółki", "kapitał zakładowy", or "reprezentacja spółki".
skills.author: Michell Hoduń (https://github.com/b44x)
skills.compatibility: Python 3.8+ (standard library only); network access to api-krs.ms.gov.pl.

skills.name: leki
skills.display_name: Leki — rejestr, opakowania i oficjalne ulotki
skills.description: Find Polish medicines by name, declared active substance or package GTIN/EAN in the official RPL export. Return exact product variants, strengths, package records and publisher-provided leaflet/SmPC links with the registry date. Use for "znajdź ulotkę leku", "substancja czynna", "sprawdź lek po kodzie kreskowym", "informacje o leku z RPL". Registry lookup does not establish pharmacy stock, reimbursement, recall status, therapeutic equivalence or a suitable treatment.
skills.author: Michell Hoduń (https://github.com/b44x)
skills.source: Rejestr Produktów Leczniczych — URPL / Centrum e-Zdrowia
skills.rate_limit: fair use; one full export GET on initial use or refresh; local index reused for 24 hours
skills.compatibility: Python 3.8+ with standard-library sqlite3; no pip dependencies.

skills.name: moja-gmina
skills.description: Search official GUS BDL statistics and compare Polish municipalities, counties or voivodeships for a common year. Use for population, local demography, construction or unemployment comparisons, finding territorial units and statistical indicators. Preserves geographic levels, units of measure and missing-data attributes.
skills.author: Michell Hoduń (https://github.com/b44x)
skills.source: Główny Urząd Statystyczny — Bank Danych Lokalnych
skills.rate_limit: Anonymous 5 requests/s, 100/15 min, 1000/12 h, 10000/week; optional BDL_API_KEY increases limits.
skills.compatibility: Python 3.8+ (standard library only); internet access required.

skills.name: nbp
skills.description: Fetch official exchange rates, calculate tax conversions for foreign currency invoices, and check gold prices from Narodowy Bank Polski (NBP). Get current or historical average rates (Table A & B) for EUR, USD, GBP, CHF, etc. Calculate foreign currency invoices in PLN according to Polish tax law (Art. 31a ustawy o VAT / Art. 11a ustawy o PIT) by automatically looking up the official NBP rate from the last business day preceding the invoice date. Convert between any currency pairs. Get official gold prices per gram and troy ounce. Use whenever the user asks about "kurs euro", "kurs dolara", "tabela NBP", "kurs do faktury", "przelicz walutę NBP", "cena złota NBP", or foreign invoice conversion.
skills.author: Michell Hoduń (https://github.com/b44x)
skills.compatibility: Python 3.8+ (standard library only); network access to api.nbp.pl.

skills.name: nfz
skills.description: Official data from the Narodowy Fundusz Zdrowia (NFZ, Polish National Health Fund) on queues, medical facilities and estimated waiting times for healthcare services (PCUŚ). Search medical services (MRI, CT, colonoscopy, gastroscopy, cardiology clinic, orthopedist, ophthalmologist), check the estimated waiting time (in days and months) and the number of waiting patients for stable and urgent cases. Find the nearest facilities within a given radius in kilometers (Haversine) and compare waiting times across hospitals and clinics. No API keys, 100% official public data from the NFZ Terminy Leczenia API. Use whenever the user asks about: "kolejki NFZ", "czas oczekiwania do kardiologa", "gdzie na rezonans na NFZ", "terminy leczenia", "poradnia NFZ w Gdańsku", "najkrótsza kolejka do endokrynologa", "NFZ czas oczekiwania".
skills.author: Michell Hoduń (https://github.com/b44x)
skills.compatibility: Python 3.8+ (standard library only); network access to apinfz.nfz.gov.pl.

skills.name: nieruchomosci
skills.description: Search actual Polish property transaction records from the official RCN register around coordinates or in a bounding box. Inspect residential units, buildings and plots; filter deed dates, market and area. Use for "za ile sprzedano mieszkania w okolicy", "ceny transakcyjne", "RCN", "sprzedaż działek". Does not search current advertisements or produce a property valuation.
skills.author: Michell Hoduń (https://github.com/b44x)
skills.source: Główny Urząd Geodezji i Kartografii — Rejestr Cen Nieruchomości
skills.rate_limit: Not published; bounded queries, at most 10 pages per run; HTTP 429 stops the command.
skills.compatibility: Python 3.8+ (standard library only); internet access required.

skills.name: odjazdy
skills.description: Find public transport stops and upcoming bus or tram departures in Gdańsk, Poznań and Szczecin using transport operators' public services. Use for "kiedy tramwaj", "odjazdy z przystanku", "opóźnienie autobusu". Distinguishes realtime predictions, schedules, canceled services and stale data. Coverage is limited to the three supported networks; no route planning or ticket purchases.
skills.author: Michell Hoduń (https://github.com/b44x)
skills.source: ZTM Gdańsk, ZTM Poznań (PEKA), ZDiTM Szczecin
skills.rate_limit: Szczecin 100 requests/minute/IP; one-shot lookups, upstream HTTP cache honored
skills.compatibility: Python 3.8+ (standard library only); internet access required except cities.

skills.name: ostrzezenia-gis
skills.description: Read official GIS product warnings from Gov.pl, search product or brand words in published notice text, and inspect exact batch numbers and dates. Use for "ostrzeżenia GIS", "wycofany produkt", "czy ta partia jest w komunikacie", recalled food or supplements. Searches a bounded set of notices; absence is not proof of product safety.
skills.author: Michell Hoduń (https://github.com/b44x)
skills.rate_limit: Local cache 5 minutes; requests spaced by 1 second per process; no published quota.
skills.compatibility: Python 3.8+ (standard library only); internet access required.

skills.name: otwarte-dane
skills.description: Discover Polish government datasets, resource metadata and reuse conditions on dane.gov.pl. Znajdź zbiory i zasoby na dane.gov.pl, ich źródła, daty aktualizacji, formaty i warunki ponownego wykorzystania. Użyj dla „znajdź otwarte dane”, „dane do analizy”, „API polskich urzędów”, „Polish open data”, „find government datasets in Poland”. Zwraca metadane i linki; nie pobiera ani nie interpretuje plików zewnętrznych.
skills.author: Michell Hoduń (https://github.com/b44x)
skills.rate_limit: fair use; page size at most 100; one request per command
skills.compatibility: Python 3.8+ (standard library only).

skills.name: prawo
skills.description: Official Polish legal acts from the Sejm ELI API (ISAP: Dziennik Ustaw, Monitor Polski). Read the wording of a specific article of a code or statute, together with the source document and date, and a warning about amendments that entered into force later. Check whether an act is in force, find its latest consolidated text (tekst jednolity), list amendments with entry-into-force dates (including upcoming ones), and search acts by title. Shortcuts for the main codes (kp, kc, kk, kpc, ksh, kpa, vat, pit, cit, op…). Use whenever the user asks about Polish law, e.g. "co mówi art. 30 Kodeksu pracy", "okres wypowiedzenia umowy o pracę", "czy ta ustawa obowiązuje", "tekst jednolity ustawy o VAT", "kiedy wchodzą zmiany w Kodeksie pracy", "Dz.U. 2023 poz. 1465", "przepisy o pracy zdalnej".
skills.author: Michell Hoduń (https://github.com/b44x)
skills.compatibility: Python 3.8+ (standard library only); network access to api.sejm.gov.pl.

skills.name: produkty
skills.description: Look up food-label data by GTIN/EAN barcode or search food names and brands in Open Food Facts, with Poland as the default declared sales-country filter. Read ingredients, reported allergen and trace tags, nutrition units and serving bases, and sourced Nutri-Score. Use for "sprawdź skład produktu", "alergeny po EAN", "kod kreskowy", "wartości odżywcze". Community data may be incomplete; does not verify allergy safety, recommend supplements, check shop stock or prices, or place orders.
skills.author: Michell Hoduń (https://github.com/b44x)
skills.source: Open Food Facts — społecznościowa baza etykiet żywności
skills.rate_limit: 15 product reads/minute/IP, 10 searches/minute/IP; product cache 24 h, search cache 15 min
skills.compatibility: Python 3.8+ (standard library only); internet access required.

skills.name: przetargi
skills.description: Search Polish public procurement contract notices in BZP by subject, buyer voivodeship, CPV and publication dates. Read notice details by full BZP notice number. Use for "znajdź przetargi", "zamówienia na strony internetowe", "ogłoszenia BZP", "przetargi IT". Read-only; does not submit offers or assert that a tender is still open.
skills.author: Michell Hoduń (https://github.com/b44x)
skills.compatibility: Python 3.8+ (standard library only); internet access required.

skills.name: sejm
skills.description: Official parliamentary data of the Sejm RP (Polish lower house) from the open API (api.sejm.gov.pl). Database of MPs of the 10th term (X kadencja) (electoral districts, parliamentary clubs, Sejm committees, contact details), detailed voting results (roll-call votes, breakdown of votes by club: for/against/abstained/absent, checking how a given MP voted), the database of druki sejmowe (Sejm prints) and the course of the legislative process (stages of work on bills and resolutions), as well as interpelacje poselskie (MPs' interpellations) and ministries' replies. No API keys, 100% official public data. Use whenever the user asks about: "posłowie na Sejm", "kto jest posłem z okręgu X", "jak głosowano w Sejmie nad ustawą Y", "jak głosował poseł Kowalski", "na jakim etapie jest projekt ustawy", "druki sejmowe", "interpelacje poselskie".
skills.author: Michell Hoduń (https://github.com/b44x)
skills.compatibility: Python 3.8+ (standard library only); network access to api.sejm.gov.pl.

skills.name: smog
skills.description: Read official GIOŚ air quality measurements and the Polish air quality index. Find stations by city or the nearest station by GPS. Use for "smog", "jakość powietrza", "PM2.5", "PM10", "najbliższa stacja GIOŚ". Shows measurement times and missing data; does not provide forecasts or medical advice.
skills.author: Michell Hoduń (https://github.com/b44x)
skills.compatibility: Python 3.8+ (standard library only); internet access required.

skills.name: solid-jobs
skills.description: Search job offers and salary statistics specifically on SOLID.Jobs, including keywords, cities, experience, remote work and contract-specific salary ranges. Use for "oferty SOLID.Jobs", "Python na SOLID.Jobs", "widełki SOLID.Jobs". This is a single-provider integration with an IT default, not a general Polish job-market search. For broad job-search requests explain the limited source coverage before using it. Does not submit applications or CVs.
skills.author: Michell Hoduń (https://github.com/b44x)
skills.rate_limit: 300 requests/minute/IP; provider cache up to 1 hour; at most 5 pages per invocation
skills.compatibility: Python 3.8+ (standard library only).

skills.name: terminy
skills.description: Polish working days, public holidays and deadlines, computed offline with legal citations. Count working days between dates, get the monthly working-time norm (wymiar czasu pracy) per art. 130 Kodeksu pracy, list statutory holidays (including Wigilia 24 December from 2025), check a single day, compute a deadline such as invoice payment terms (date + N days, moved to the next working day under art. 115 KC), and list monthly tax and social-security deadlines (ZUS, PIT, CIT, VAT/JPK_V7M, PPK) moved off weekends and holidays per art. 12 § 5 Ordynacji podatkowej. Use whenever the user asks e.g. "ile dni roboczych w październiku", "wymiar czasu pracy grudzień", "do kiedy zapłacić ZUS", "termin VAT za wrzesień", "czy 24 grudnia jest wolny", "termin płatności 14 dni od faktury", "kiedy wypada Boże Ciało".
skills.author: Michell Hoduń (https://github.com/b44x)
skills.source: Polskie przepisy (ustawa o dniach wolnych od pracy, Kodeks pracy, Ordynacja podatkowa, Kodeks cywilny, ustawy podatkowe)
skills.compatibility: Python 3.8+ (standard library only); works fully offline.
